page.notes: Greek words in the text and notes (ῥοιζηδὸν, μετάνοια, μεταμέλεια) are uncertain; the Greek in the left-hand reference notes is read approximately. The word "plancu" is doubtful, as are "quuntura" and the marginal "tem / tanto" pair. "Quæ" and "Tanitentiâ" in the right margin are read from a small, slightly blurred scan. The printed asterisks and daggers are marked as reference symbols. No catchword or signature is visible at the foot of the page.
